name: Durga Kullakanda
heading: About Me
tagline: Physician by day, hobbyist photographer by whenever I have free time.
bio: Hi, my name is Durga. I'm an internal medicine physician in San Francisco. Photography is my hobby — I shoot mostly on a Sony A7V wherever I happen to be.
